summary: Sample app implemented. Unit tests passed, seed script inserted sample data into the live DocumentDB cluster, aggregation pipeline executed and returned grouped exposures by maturity bucket and rate type. The LLM end-to-end call was not executed (no OPENAI_API_KEY provided). An attempt to use the documentdb_create_index MCP tool failed; index was created programmatically during aggregation.
how_to_run:
1) Set env vars DOCUMENTDB_URI and optionally OPENAI_API_KEY.
2) pip install -r requirements.txt
3) python -m src.seed  # idempotent
4) python -c "from src.aggregation_tool import summarize_positions; import json; print(json.dumps(summarize_positions(), indent=2, default=str))"
5) To run LLM analysis: python -m src.agent (requires OPENAI_API_KEY)
